messages:
Rae: quick play: added compact sparklines to the team dashboard header. They render tiny and need clear threshold indicators. Putting this here for feedback.
Owen: love the density but two issues: 1) legend swatches disappear at <48px width, 2) thresholds (SLA lines) are hard to see on dark backgrounds.
Priya: accessibility: tiny sparklines must expose a summary for screen readers: 'Last 24h trend: up 12% with 3 breaches'. Use aria-label on the container and make the individual points navigable.
Nell: UX nit: when legend text truncates we currently show ellipsis but no tooltip. Suggest tooltip on hover and focus that reads full series name and current value.
Rae: good call. Also thinking of a micro-legend: show only icon + value, click to expand a panel with full chart. Reduces clutter on list views.
Owen: threshold rendering: propose dashed line with 2px outer glow (soft) and a small diamond marker for breach points. Color should be colorblind-friendly and pass AA when used over our dark bg.
Priya: color palette: avoid green/red pairings. Use blue for normal, orange for warning, purple for critical? At minimum add pattern fills for chevrons when printing in B/W.
Nell: interaction: keyboard nav should let you tab into each sparkline, then arrow-left/right to move points; Enter toggles expansion panel. When a breach exists, pressing B should jump to next breach point. Announce 'Breach at 2026-03-10T09:12:34, value 3.2'
Rae: good idea. Also: tiny sparklines currently compute smoothing by default which blunts short spikes; for SLA breaches we should disable smoothing for series with >1 breach in window.
Owen: algorithm suggestion: compute spike_count = count(points > threshold). If spike_count / total > 0.02 or spike_count >= 2 then smoothing = false. Documentable rule.
Priya: live region: when dashboard loads and any series has a breach, SR should get an announcement '3 series breached thresholds in view'. Also when user tabs to a sparkline announce relative rank '3rd highest errors in view'.
Nell: export behavior: CSV should include columns 'point_index', 'value', 'is_breach', 'displayed_value' to match other chart exports. Also add 'sparkline_summary' metadata: 'trend_up|trend_down|flat|breaches=3'.
Rae: microcopy for expansion panel header: 'Errors — sparkline summary 37 breaches in last 24h'. Keep it short for narrow panes.
Owen: perf: rendering thousands of sparklines on a page kills paint. We should use canvas for compact sparklines with an optional SVG vector for expanded view. Use requestIdleCallback to render non-visible rows.
Priya: ensure canvas sparklines still provide accessibility hooks: add an offscreen SVG or aria-hidden table with summary rows for SR users.
Nell: visual hint when values are clipped: tiny "+" badge on the right edge and tooltip 'value clipped'. Keyboard focus must include the badge and read raw value.
GraphBot: preview: https://staging.redwood.com/visuals/sparkline-compact-2389 1 snapshot ux-2389
Rae: action items: Owen prototype pattern fill + palette options; Priya draft a11y announcements and keyboard flows; Nell add tooltip behavior and export schema; I'll wire smoothing rule and expansion panel copy.
Priya: will also add tests for live region messages and ensure they don't flood on initial load (debounce 2s).
Nell: assigning tasks in the design doc. Review next Wed.
Rae: thanks all :)
